commands.command: bash -c aws sts get-caller-identity --output json | jq '.UserId = "<redacted>"'
commands.proves: Credentials are valid; AWS STS identifies the caller

commands.command: bash -c aws configure list --profile "${AWS_PROFILE:-default}" >/dev/null && jq -n --arg r "$(aws configure get region)" '{credentials_configured:true, access_key_id:"<not recorded>", region:$r}'
commands.proves: A credential source and region are configured (key ID not recorded)

commands.command: aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name meetcost-stack --region us-east-1 --query Stacks[0].{StackName:StackName,Status:StackStatus,Created:CreationTime,LastUpdated:LastUpdatedTime,Outputs:Outputs} --output json
commands.proves: The stack exists, its status, creation time and public outputs

commands.command: aws cloudformation describe-stack-events --stack-name meetcost-stack --region us-east-1 --query StackEvents[?ResourceType==`AWS::CloudFormation::Stack`].{Timestamp:Timestamp,Status:ResourceStatus} --output json
commands.proves: Every create/update of the stack, with timestamps

commands.command: aws cloudformation list-stack-resources --stack-name meetcost-stack --region us-east-1 --query StackResourceSummaries[].{LogicalId:LogicalResourceId,Type:ResourceType,Status:ResourceStatus} --output json

bash -c for f in meetcost-calculate-cost meetcost-get-recommendations; do aws lambda get-function-configuration --function-name $f --region us-east-1 --query '{Name:FunctionName,Runtime:Runtime,Memory:MemorySize,Timeout:Timeout,LastModified:LastModified,ModelId:Environment.Variables.BEDROCK_MODEL_ID}' --output json; done | jq -s .

curl -s -X POST https://zlxv6jurt6.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prod/get-recommendations -H Content-Type: application/json -H x-api-key: <api-key> -d {"subject":"Q4 sales pipeline review","duration_minutes":60,"attendees":[{"name":"Alice","role":"VP Sales","seniority":"executive","hourly_rate":400},{"name":"Bob","role":"Backend Developer","seniority":"junior","hourly_rate":50},{"name":"Carol","role":"Account Executive","seniority":"senior","hourly_rate":200}],"total_cost":650}
